objective.name: Green Machine
objective.text: Win if Blue wins four missions and at least 20 Green tokens were added to missions across the whole table and game. All sources count: paid deposits, Green reserves, ability bonuses, and tokens recolored into Green. Later theft or recoloring away from Green does not erase prior additions. Your tracker shows the table-wide total after each resolution.

progress.label: Green added across the table
progress.text: Green added across the table: 19 / 20. Your own paid Green deposits: 0. Updated after each resolved attempt. Blue must also win the game.

objective.name: Opposition Patron
objective.text: Win if Blue wins four missions and at least 20 originally paid Red tokens were deposited by all players combined across the whole game. Bonuses, penalties, and recoloring do not count. Later theft does not erase deposits; paying a recovered token again counts again. Your tracker shows the table-wide total after each resolution.
